title: 第20章 失控第21章 学徒
slug: 诡秘星轨交织的夜第222章
content_zh:
然而，在伦纳德的意识里，另一个苍老而带着些许戏谑的声音正通过某种特殊的方式与他交流。
“啧啧，这动静可不小啊，小子。”那苍老的声音带着一丝玩味，“这情况，她十有**是晋升失败了，还极有可能失控，你准备一下吧。”
伦纳德在心中急急回应，“老头，别光看热闹！她这情况到底怎么回事？能撑过去吗？序列七失控可不是开玩笑的。”
“放心好啦，以她的途径，就算是失控，也不会有什么大事情，”帕列斯·索罗亚斯德的语气也稍微认真了些，“有你们几个，很轻松就能对付她。”
“谁想知道这个了，”伦纳德有些气急败坏，他想看看莫甘娜的情况，但是邓恩没有开口，他们也不敢有什么动作，只能干看着，“她就不能不失控吗？”
帕列斯刚刚准备回答，倒在地上的“莫甘娜”忽然发生变化。
“莫甘娜”那急促而痛苦的喘息声也逐渐平复，变得悠长而规律。
脸上那不正常的惨白开始褪去，浮现出一抹淡淡的、近乎透明的光泽，仿佛有微弱的星辉在她皮肤下流淌。
然后——“莫甘娜”缓缓地，睁开了眼睛。
那双眸子，不再是之前的深邃蓝色，而是变成了一种奇异的、仿佛蕴藏着无数细碎星光的深黑色。
眼神空洞、漠然，失去了所有人类应有的情感色彩，只是静静地望着炼金室布满斑驳痕迹的天花板。
“成……成功了？”老尼尔迟疑地停下了咒文，不确定地看向邓恩。
邓恩队长没有放松警惕，他依旧紧盯着莫甘娜，沉声道，“莫甘娜？你能听到我说话吗？感觉怎么样？”
地上的“莫甘娜”对邓恩的呼唤毫无反应，她只是静静地躺着，那双眸子一眨不眨。
伦纳德心中的帕列斯却突然发出了警示，“动手！她失控了！”
仿佛是为了印证帕列斯的话，“莫甘娜”的身体突然以一种完全不符合人体工学的、如同提线木偶般的姿势，直挺挺地从地上“立”了起来！
她的动作僵硬，关节发出细微的、令人牙酸的摩擦声。
“莫甘娜”转过头，那双空洞的星眸扫过在场的三人，没有任何焦点，只有一片冰冷的、非人的漠然。
“她失控了！”邓恩瞬间做出判断，不再犹豫，发出指令，“制伏她！”
话音未落，一股强大的、令人心智迟缓、昏昏欲睡的精神力量如同无形的波纹，以邓恩为中心向“莫甘娜”笼罩而去——梦魇的能力！

然而，这股足以让序列低者瞬间陷入沉眠的力量，在接触到“莫甘娜”周身那层无形的、仿佛由星光构成的灵性壁垒时，竟如同微风拂过山岩，仅仅让她动作停滞了半秒。
梦魇，没有起作用！
“莫甘娜”那双星眸转向邓恩，率先暴露攻击意图的邓恩，是她的第一攻击目标。
紧接着，也不见她有任何念动咒文或做出仪式的动作，炼金室内的光线骤然扭曲、黯淡，被某种奇异的力量吞噬、偏折了。
无数冰冷的、锐利的、由纯粹星光凝聚而成的虚幻尖刺，凭空出现在邓恩、老尼尔和伦纳德的周围，带着刺骨的寒意和撕裂灵性的锋锐，如同暴雨般向他们攒射而来！
冥冥之中，某种既定的、充满恶意的“叙事”正在被书写，悄然覆盖了现实的走向。
content_en:
However, in Leonard's consciousness, another old and slightly joking voice was communicating with him in a special way.
"Tsk, tsk, this movement is quite big, kid." The old voice said with a hint of amusement, "In this case, she will most likely fail the promotion, and it is very possible that she will lose control. You should be prepared."
Leonard responded urgently in his mind, "Old man, don't just watch the fun! What's going on with her situation? Can she survive it? Losing control at Sequence 7 is no joke."
"Don't worry, with her way, even if she loses control, it won't be a big deal," Pales Zoroaster's tone became a little more serious, "With the few of you, we can easily deal with her."
"Who wants to know this?" Leonard was a little angry. He wanted to see Morgana's condition, but Dunn didn't speak, and they didn't dare to make any move. They could only watch, "Can't she not lose control?"
Just as Pales was about to answer, "Morgana" who fell on the ground suddenly changed.
"Morgana's" rapid and painful breathing gradually subsided and became long and regular.
The abnormal paleness on her face began to fade away, revealing a faint, almost transparent luster, as if there was a faint starlight flowing under her skin.
Then——"Morgana" slowly opened her eyes.
Those eyes were no longer the deep blue before, but turned into a strange deep black that seemed to contain countless tiny starlights.
His eyes were empty and indifferent, losing all the emotional color that humans should have. He just stared quietly at the mottled ceiling of the alchemy room.
"Is it...successful?" Old Neil stopped the spell hesitantly and looked at Dunn uncertainly.
Captain Dunn did not let down his guard. He still stared at Morgana and said in a deep voice, "Morgana? Can you hear me? How do you feel?"
"Morgana" on the ground didn't respond to Dunn's call. She just lay quietly, her eyes unblinking.
Pales in Leonard's heart suddenly issued a warning, "Do it! She's out of control!"
As if to confirm what Pales said, "Morgana"'s body suddenly stood up straight from the ground in a completely unergonomic, puppet-like posture!
Her movements were stiff, and her joints made a subtle, tooth-aching friction sound.
"Morgana" turned her head, and her empty starry eyes swept across the three people present. There was no focus, only a cold, inhuman indifference.
"She's out of control!" Dunn made an instant judgment, no longer hesitated, and gave the order, "Subjugate her!"
Before he finished speaking, a powerful, mind-slowing, drowsy spiritual power was like an invisible ripple, centered on Dunn and enveloped "Morgana" - the ability of nightmares!
However, this power, which is enough to put a low-sequence person into a deep sleep in an instant, when it comes into contact with the invisible spiritual barrier around "Morgana" that seems to be made of starlight, it is like a breeze blowing through the rocks, only stopping her movements for half a second.
Nightmare, not working!
"Morgana's" starry eyes turned to Dunn. Dunn, who was the first to reveal her attack intention, was her first target.
Immediately afterwards, she was not seen chanting any incantations or making any ritual movements. The light in the alchemy room suddenly distorted and dimmed, and was swallowed up and deflected by some strange power.
Countless cold, sharp, illusory spikes condensed from pure starlight appeared out of thin air around Dunn, Old Neil, and Leonard, shooting towards them like a torrential rain with biting chill and soul-rending sharpness!
In the dark, a certain established and malicious "narrative" is being written, quietly covering the direction of reality.
